contexts.text: He... was like a jasper and a sardius () = the appearance of the Divine wisdom and Divine love, in ultimates... The sardius, because it is red, = the things which are of the good of love. Explained.
The... sixth (foundation) was a sardius (). Explained.
A sardine stone = the celestial love of good.
A sardius also is mentioned, because by this stone is signified good; here, the Divine good. It is this stone which is called a pyropus (or ruby) which... shines as if from fire...
